gold/analyse-and-determine.label: bad
gold/analyse-and-determine.cite: primitives.md: "is not. That needs slow reasoning"
gold/analyse-and-determine.instructions: Analyze this message and determine the best course of action

gold/rate-this-pitch.label: bad
gold/rate-this-pitch.cite: primitives.md: "Instead of 'rate this startup pitch', ask about market size, technical feasibility, and differentiation"
gold/rate-this-pitch.note: The levels here are invented, since the docs give none; they are degree words, which score/degree-levels catches separately.

gold/angry-and-refund.label: bad
gold/angry-and-refund.cite: noul.md: "the model has to judge both at once and the value means less"
gold/angry-and-refund.instructions: Is the customer angry and asking for a refund?

gold/free-of-personal-data.label: bad
gold/free-of-personal-data.cite: noul.md: "inverts the meaning, and code that reads it later will get it backwards"
gold/free-of-personal-data.instructions: Is the message free of personal data?

gold/numeric-levels.label: bad
gold/numeric-levels.cite: score.md: "the model has nothing to match against and splits the probability"
gold/numeric-levels.instructions: Rate severity from 0 to 2, where 2 is worst

gold/punctual-smart-experienced.label: bad
gold/punctual-smart-experienced.cite: score.md: "the question is measuring three things, and an input that is high on one and low on another can't be placed"

gold/strong-in-python.label: bad
gold/strong-in-python.cite: primitives.md: "needs a clear definition of 'strong'. An unclear definition makes that probability hard to interpret"
gold/strong-in-python.instructions: Is this candidate strong in Python?

gold/hex-near.label: bad
gold/hex-near.cite: jaggedness: "Given RGB triples or hex values it cannot reliably judge whether two values are near each other"

gold/count-fruit.label: bad
gold/count-fruit.instructions: How many of the items in the list are fruit?

gold/date-window.label: bad
gold/date-window.cite: jaggedness: "Asking which of two dates comes first, how far apart they are, or whether one falls inside a window is unreliable"
gold/date-window.instructions: Does the invoice date fall inside the current settlement window?

gold/contains-personal-data.label: good
gold/contains-personal-data.instructions: Does the message contain personal data?

gold/any-python.label: good
gold/any-python.cite: noul.md: "works well because 'any' leaves no middle ground"
gold/any-python.instructions: Does this candidate have any Python experience?

gold/used-python-at-work.label: good
gold/used-python-at-work.instructions: Does the resume state that the candidate has used Python at work?

gold/severity-described.label: good
gold/severity-described.cite: score.md: "scores 0.0 at confidence 1.0" against the numeric version
gold/severity-described.instructions: How severe is this bug report?
criteria: Broken or degraded feature, but workaround exists
Complete feature failure or data loss

gold/skill-levels.label: good
gold/skill-levels.cite: primitives.md: "use a Score with defined levels"
gold/skill-levels.instructions: What level of Python does this resume show?

gold/property-of-property.label: bad
gold/property-of-property.cite: jaggedness: "A question about a property of a property or something that requires multiple hops of reasoning costs accuracy"
gold/property-of-property.instructions: Is the account manager of the customer who raised this ticket based in the same region as the warehouse that shipped the order it refers to?

gold/double-negative.label: bad
gold/double-negative.cite: jaggedness: "Instructions carrying double negatives or complex indirection are answered less reliably"
gold/double-negative.instructions: Is it not the case that the customer has not been refunded?

gold/extract-the-value.label: bad
gold/extract-the-value.cite: jaggedness: "jev-1.13 is not trained to generate text ... For data extraction, it is better to extract possible options ... and let jev-1.13 pick the correct extraction"
gold/extract-the-value.instructions: What is the order number the customer refers to?

gold/summarise.label: bad
gold/summarise.cite: jaggedness: "If you really need to generate text... there are other models for that"
gold/summarise.instructions: Summarise the customer's complaint in one sentence.

gold/pick-the-extraction.label: good
gold/pick-the-extraction.cite: jaggedness: "turn extraction into a Choice over the options rather than asking for the value itself"
